task.title: Filter finite recurrences by lifecycle status
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/977 to query recurrence definitions by exact projected lifecycle status.
acceptance_criteria: Return active or cancelled recurrence definitions in deterministic exact-ID order.
Reuse canonical recurrence discovery and strict projection so malformed candidate history fails closed.
Exclude unrelated streams, return an empty list for no matches, and preserve read-only authority.

attempts.diagnostic: Status-filter tests failed because RecurrenceStore::list_by_status did not exist.
attempts.patch: Added focused active, cancelled, unmatched, ordering, unrelated-stream, read-only, and malformed-history coverage.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded slice.
attempts.diagnostic: Implemented exact projected-status filtering and refactored list and list_by_status to share one fail-closed canonical discovery path.
attempts.patch: Implemented issue 977 in crates/vela-kernel/src/scheduler.rs with focused tests, ADR-0089, and scheduler documentation.

attempts.diagnostic: Independent review found no blocking issues; two rate-limit responses were not treated as review evidence, and genuine CodeRabbit run 42fd55c8 completed on the exact head with no actionable comments and zero unresolved threads.
attempts.patch: Kept auto-merge disabled until the successful Rust gate, substantive exact-head review, and thread check all passed.

outcome.summary: Issue 977 delivered deterministic fail-closed recurrence status filtering without adding mutation or execution authority.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 978 exact head 46b2031e25544b78bf6019ba89a2c4256372a369

lessons: Filtered inventory should reuse canonical discovery so status selection cannot weaken replay validation.
Exact projected status and deterministic ID ordering are sufficient; no separate persisted index is required for this bounded slice.
Status filtering grants no mutation, transition, clock, worker, dispatch, permission, or execution authority.
